# Best Man Speech AI

> A free tool that turns your own stories about the groom into a best man speech draft. Answer seven short questions, get a structured speech in under a minute. No account, no email, no payment.

Best Man Speech AI does not store the content of speeches or the personal details entered into the form. Alongside the generator we publish free written guides on speech structure, timing, delivery, and etiquette.

Key facts:
- Cost: free
- Signup required: no
- Output: personalized speech draft plus PDF download
- Recommended best man speech length: 3–5 minutes, roughly 500–750 words
- Contact: help@bestmanspeechai.com

## Tools

- [Best Man Speech Generator](https://www.bestmanspeechai.com/creator): Answer seven questions about the groom and your relationship; returns a full speech draft with an opening, stories, a turn toward the couple, and a toast.

## Guides

- [How to Write a Great Best Man Speech](https://www.bestmanspeechai.com/how-to-write-a-speech): The complete four-step process — brainstorm and outline, structure, write and refine, practice and deliver. Covers openings, storytelling, acknowledging the partner, closing toasts, and common mistakes.
- [Best Man Speech Tips](https://www.bestmanspeechai.com/tips): Do's and don'ts, speech length, how to open, what to avoid, when the speech happens in the reception, and whether to memorize or read.
- [Bachelor Party Speech Guide](https://www.bestmanspeechai.com/bachelor-party-speech): The shorter, looser toast — finding an angle, picking one story, how far the roasting can go, and when in the evening to speak.
- [Best Man Speech for Two Grooms](https://www.bestmanspeechai.com/twogrooms): Speaking at a same-sex wedding — who gives the speech, honouring both grooms, and which traditional jokes to drop.
